column1: # versions.tsv — the one reviewed manifest of tool versions (objective `pins`).
# Read by opt/lib/pins.sh (`pins_want <tool> <fallback>`, used for the installers'
# defaults) and by `fleet pins status|bump|apply` (sdk/fleet/internal/pins).
# `fleet pins bump` rewrites only the version field, so keep one row per tool.
# Columns (whitespace-separated; `#` comments and blank lines are ignored and kept):
#   tool       [a-z0-9-]+, unique
#   track      pin    - install exactly this version
#              floor  - any installed version >= this one is fine (rust)
#              latest - follow upstream; version is `-` (or a version used only
#                       when the host forces pins with `gff set pins.track.mode pin`)
#   version    semver without a leading v; `-` (latest only); or `@<path>`, which
#              reads the trimmed content of that repo-relative file (go → .go-version)
#   upstream   gh:<owner>/<repo> | go: | text:<url> | -   (where `fleet pins status`
#              looks up the newest release)
#   installer  repo-relative script that converges the tool, or `-` = report-only
#              (status shows drift, apply lists it but runs nothing)
#   probe      rest of the line: shell command whose output contains the installed
#              version; `-` = none
# Per-host override: gff flag pins.track.mode (manifest | latest | pin). Per-run
# override: each installer's own env var (e.g. SOPS_VERSION=3.12.0) still wins.
go          pin     @.go-version  go:                          -                                     go version
uv          pin     0.13.0        gh:astral-sh/uv              opt/scripts/system/install_uv.sh      uv --version
glow        pin     3.0.0         gh:charmbracelet/glow        opt/scripts/system/install_glow.sh    glow --version
1password-cli  pin  2.41.0  -  opt/scripts/system/install_1password.sh  op --version
lastpass-cli pin 1.6.1 gh:lastpass/lastpass-cli opt/scripts/system/install_lastpass.sh lpass --version
rust        floor   1.99.0        gh:rust-lang/rust            opt/scripts/system/install_rust.sh    rustc --version
sops        pin     3.13.3        gh:getsops/sops              opt/scripts/system/install_sops.sh    sops --version --disable-version-check
yq          pin     4.54.1        gh:mikefarah/yq              opt/scripts/system/install_yq.sh      yq --version
gitleaks    pin     8.30.1        gh:gitleaks/gitleaks         opt/scripts/git/install_gitleaks.sh   gitleaks version
kubectl     pin     1.37.1        text:https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt  opt/scripts/system/install_k8s_tools.sh  kubectl version --client
helm        pin     4.3.0         gh:helm/helm                 opt/scripts/system/install_k8s_tools.sh  helm version --short
kind        pin     0.33.0        gh:kubernetes-sigs/kind      opt/scripts/system/install_k8s_tools.sh  kind version
herdr       latest  -             -                            opt/scripts/system/install_herdr.sh   herdr --version
keyd        pin     2.6.0         gh:rvaiya/keyd               -                                     keyd --version
nerd-fonts  pin     3.5.1         gh:ryanoasis/nerd-fonts      -                                     -
vault       pin     1.21.4        gh:hashicorp/vault           -                                     vault version
docker-compose  pin  2.23.3  gh:docker/compose  -  -
nvm         pin     0.39.7        gh:nvm-sh/nvm                opt/scripts/system/install_nvm.sh     bash -c '. "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 && nvm --version'
golangci-lint  pin  2.14.0  gh:golangci/golangci-lint  -  -
